title: The Brain
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json, films/qkv_data.json, experiments/logs.

blocks.text: One question. How many city e-bike battery packs do we have in Manchester stores?
blocks.say: One question. How many city e-bike battery packs do we have in Manchester stores?

blocks.text: One hundred tokens go in. Twenty-four blocks of a real language model turn them over. At every step, one token is chosen from 151,936.
blocks.say: One hundred tokens go in. Twenty-four blocks of a real language model turn them over. At every step, one token is chosen from one hundred and fifty-one thousand, nine hundred and thirty-six.

blocks.text: And out comes a confident answer: 100. The truth is 5,400. Today we open the machine, and find out where that number came from.
blocks.say: And out comes a confident answer: one hundred. The truth is five thousand four hundred. Today we open the machine, and find out where that number came from.
